selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Shows successful sysctl application, persistent file contents, and zero values for accept_redirects and accept_source_route before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e; safe restart acknowledgement; changed boot ID c8328205-2614-42a0-af26-d3700391c528; recovered system, networking, persistent file, and hardened runtime state.

commands.command:
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1; printf 'networkmanager='; systemctl is-active NetworkManager 2>&1; printf '%s
' 'ipv4_hardening_runtime:'; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; printf '%s
' 'addresses:'; ip -4 -brief address show; printf '%s
' 'routes:'; ip -4 route show
commands.stdout:
boot_id=437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e
system_state=running
networkmanager=active
ipv4_hardening_runtime:
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 1
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
addresses:
lo               UNKNOWN        127.0.0.1/8 
enp1s0           UP             10.100.255.10/24 
routes:
default via 10.100.255.1 dev enp1s0 proto dhcp src 10.100.255.10 metric 100 
10.100.255.0/24 dev enp1s0 proto kernel scope link src 10.100.255.10 metric 100

commands.command: if [ -e /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf ]; then printf '%s\n' 'existing_file:'; sed -n '1,160p' /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; else printf '%s\n' 'existing_file=absent'; fi

install -m 0644 /dev/null /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf && cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
# Disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects and source-routed packets.
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_source_route = 0
ANTRIEB_EOF
sysctl --system
